comment: No family on the signal input or the eight outputs: the module carries whatever is patched. Every output is cleared to 0V each sample before the selected one is written (src/MentalSwitch8.cpp:55-58), so an unselected output is a hard 0V rather than a held value. The panel prints 1, 2 and 4 beside the three address jacks.
